column2: CAUTION Excavated Materials Setback Sign, Keep Tools And Pipe Back, for Utility Trenching Sites, 8x12 Rust-Resistant UV-Resistant Aluminum Pre-Drilled Safety Sign by CGAP Safety
column3:
Keep Tools And Pipe Back. This CAUTION Excavated Materials Setback sign from CGAP Safety reads: KEEP TOOLS AND MATERIAL / BACK FROM TRENCH EDGE / TWO FEET MINIMUM. Written for utility trenching sites, road and sewer contractors, building foundations, general contractors.

Why this sign matters

Tools or pipe rolling or sliding into a trench edge walkway. The sign tells crews at the excavated materials setback what to watch for and what to do, so a minor or moderate injury is avoided.

Where to post it

Mount on the barricade line parallel to the trench edge, at eye level where people approach the excavated materials setback.

Who orders it

Excavation contractors, underground utility foremen, competent persons, site superintendents, safety managers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: ANSI Z535.4 CAUTION; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart C general safety and housekeeping; site practice. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
